slides.title: Interviewers hear it 10 times a day
slides.body: It sounds rehearsed and dodges the question. They want self-awareness, not a humble-brag.

slides.title: Pick a real, fixable weakness
slides.body: Something that won't break the job: public speaking, saying no, over-explaining in emails.

slides.title: Show what you're doing about it
slides.body: *Weakness + action + progress.* That's the whole formula.

slides.title: Example
slides.body: "I used to freeze while presenting. So I joined our college debate club and now I present our weekly project updates."
